engine: the one circular UI vocabulary EVER + Springs share: ring buttons, <- -> arrows, a '+' that rotates to ×, a teardrop pin, POI chips, and a wordmark->monogram collapse. Harvested from the live read (P21).

measured_live.vocabulary: everything is border-radius:50% + a 1px stroke + currentColor (inherits the section ink). Ring buttons (~44px, hover-brighten); <- -> outline arrows; a '+' expander = 2 pseudo-bars that rotate(45deg) into × on open; teardrop pin = border-radius 50% 50% 50% 0 rotate(-45) (inner content un-rotated); circular POI chips on maps; the centre wordmark COLLAPSES to a circular monogram on first scroll (two stacked marks crossfaded).
measured_live.why: one consistent circular family makes every control across the site (arrows, expanders, pins, monogram) feel like one brand — cheap cohesion.

parts..cui-arrows: inline-flex pair of ring buttons for <- ->.
parts..cui-plus: ring + 2 pseudo-bars; .is-open rotates 45deg (+ -> ×); JS toggles on click.
parts..cui-pin: teardrop map pin (rotate -45 + inner un-rotate); .cui-pin--ghost = outline.
parts..cui-brand: wordmark->monogram: .cui-brand__full + .cui-brand__mono stacked; .is-mono crossfades to the monogram (JS toggles on scroll past monoAt).

monoAt.what: scroll distance after which the brand collapses to the monogram.

entry: CircularUI.init(opts) -> { collapseBrand }. Also CircularUI.ring('prev'|'next'|'plus', {size,label}) builds a ring button element. Pairs with theme-tween (currentColor) + carousel/menu/map (the arrows/pins/chips).
law: transform (rotate) + opacity (crossfade/hover) only; all shapes from border-radius + 1px stroke + currentColor; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop. Inherits the section ink so it recolors with theme-tween.
gate_mode: eye-check + state checks (it is a UI vocabulary, not a scroll mechanic): the '+' toggles to × on click, the wordmark collapses to the monogram past monoAt (full opacity -> ~0, mono ~0 -> 1), all shapes render in currentColor.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO -> 'Q' monogram on scroll (full op 0.07 / mono 0.92 after scroll past 40px); '+' toggles is-open (-> ×); 5 ring buttons + 2 teardrop pins + 3 POI chips render in cream ink. window.__LAB_OK__ set.
